name: teltonika_ftc921
description: AVL parameters that Traccar's Teltonika decoder leaves as raw io<id> values, taken from the Teltonika Telematics wiki page for the FTC921. Note that Traccar decodes several IDs only when the device's model field is set to a matching FT[A-Z]nnn value.

io800.name: External power
io800.description: AVL ID 800, External Voltage in mV. Traccar decodes this to `power` only when the device's model field matches FT[A-Z]nnn; with the model unset it arrives raw.

io70.name: PCB temperature
io70.description: AVL ID 70. The documented range of -550..1150 for a degrees-Celsius value means it is sent in tenths.

io1148.name: Connectivity quality
io1148.description: AVL ID 1148. NOT a dBm value: four bytes packed into one word, least significant first -- RSSI, RSRP, SINR, RSRQ. Each is an unsigned magnitude of a negative dBm figure, except SINR, which is fifths of a dB offset by -20 per the model's parameter page. 0x099b6549 decodes to RSSI -73 dBm, RSRP -101 dBm, SINR +11 dB, RSRQ -9 dB, matching what the device's own log prints for that record. The word itself is ignored because its value is meaningless on its own; it was published as signal_strength in dBm, which put readings like 272725845 dBm into long-term statistics. Populated only in LTE, eMTC and NB-IoT modes. The four are filed as diagnostics, beside the Signal level bar count, and left enabled.

io1149.name: LTE band
io1149.description: AVL ID 1149. The LTE band the modem is attached to, 1..85 in LTE, eMTC and NB-IoT modes; 0 means none available. Traccar's Teltonika decoder does not register 1149, so it arrives raw. A band number identifies a band rather than measuring anything, so it carries no unit and no state class -- averaging band 4 and band 12 is not a number. The device does not send this unless the parameter is enabled in its configuration.

io255.name: Over speeding
io255.description: AVL ID 255, the speed at which an overspeed event triggered.

io254.name: Eco driving value
io254.description: AVL ID 254. The document gives the unit as 'G or rad' depending on configuration, so no device class is claimed.

io237.name: Network type
io237.description: AVL ID 237. Value meanings from the FTC305 parameter page, which documents them where the FTC921 page leaves the cell blank; 2 and 99 are confirmed against an FTC921's own offline log, which prints 'Network type: 2 [LTE (4G)]' and 'Network type: 99 [UNKNOWN]'. Note this is NOT the FMB-family enum, where 2 means eMTC.

io641.name: ICCID
io641.description: AVL ID 641, the SIM's ICCID, sent as 22 ASCII bytes. Traccar decodes only VIN and DTCs out of a variable-length IO element and hex-dumps everything else, so this arrives as twice as many hex characters: 3839313033... is 89103000... 'decode' undoes that, and passes the value through untouched if it is not hex after all. entity_category is restated because an override inherits nothing from the built-in mapping, and a SIM identifier is a diagnostic.

rssi.name: Signal level
rssi.description: Teltonika AVL ID 21, 'GSM Signal'. Traccar registers 21 unconditionally (register(21, any, ...) -> KEY_RSSI), so it never arrives as io21 and an io21 entry here would be dead configuration. The value is a 0..5 bar count, NOT dBm -- the real RSSI in dBm is the io1148 rssi field, which is why this one is renamed. state_class is set explicitly because a bar count has no unit and no device class to infer one from, and without it the reading would keep no history. entity_category is restated because an override inherits nothing from the built-in mapping, which files this one under diagnostics and creates it switched off, as the built-in mapping does.

io9.name: Analog input 1
io9.description: AVL ID 9, Analog Input 1. Reported in millivolts.

io12.name: Fuel used (GNSS)
io12.description: AVL ID 12, Fuel Used GNSS. Reported in millilitres, and cumulative, so it is a total rather than a measurement.

io200.name: Sleep mode
io200.description: AVL ID 200, Sleep Mode. 1 and 2 are listed as not used, so they are left unlabelled and would show as numbers.

io205.name: GSM cell ID
io205.description: AVL ID 205, GSM base station ID. An identifier, not a quantity, so no unit and no state class -- averaging cell IDs is not a number.

io206.name: GSM area code
io206.description: AVL ID 206, Location Area Code (LAC). An identifier, not a quantity.
